sections.description: Independent diagnostics, recovery and isolated restore rehearsal for WordPress, with backup status verified separately and usage metered against a central service.
sections.installation: Upload the zip through Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin, or extract it into wp-content/plugins/, then activate AutoRepair AI Hosting Beta.
sections.changelog:
0.20.13

  • Self-hosted update feed (pre_set_site_transient_update_plugins / plugins_api).
  • Translation support with a .pot template and an English catalogue.
  • uninstall.php that removes this plugin's options, transients, scheduled events and its own table.
  • readme.txt in the WordPress format.
